architecture.mechanism: Immersive demonstrations with force feedback lead to more consistent and efficient trajectories that agents can successfully imitate
architecture.intervention: Incorporate force feedback during the demonstration phase of policy training, providing haptic feedback to human operators when manipulating objects to capture more physically consistent manipulation strategies
architecture.expected_effect: The trained policy will develop more robust manipulation strategies less dependent on visual proxies, maintaining >98% placement success across novel SKUs without recalibration
architecture.falsification_test: Compare placement success rates of policies trained with force feedback demonstrations versus those without, using a holdout set of 50 novel objects with varied shapes and textures
